text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Fi (Program Televisyen)

(Jabatan Penyiaran Malaysia) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Mac 2022.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini, "Ketua Pengarah" ertinya Ketua Pengarah

Jabatan Penyiaran Malaysia.

Fi dan pembayaran

3. (1) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (2) dan (3) Jadual hendaklah dibayar

kepada Ketua Pengarah bagi pembekalan program televisyen mengikut kategori yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dan hendaklah dikenakan mengikut jam bagi setiap

siaran program televisyen.

(2) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (4) Jadual hendaklah dibayar kepada

Ketua Pengarah bagi pembekalan program televisyen mengikut kategori yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) dan hendaklah dikenakan mengikut jam bagi setiap program televisyen.

Remitan

4. Ketua Pengarah boleh meremitkan fi yang ditetapkan di bawah Perintah ini

sama ada secara keseluruhan atau sebahagian atau secara am atau dalam mana-mana kes

atau kelas kes yang tertentu.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 3]

1. Bagi maksud Jadual ini, "program televisyen bagi siaran terhad" ertinya suatu

program televisyen yang disiarkan secara berulang kali di dalam suatu bangunan,

premis atau pengangkutan awam.

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (TELEVISION PROGRAMME)

(DEPARTMENT OF BROADCASTING MALAYSIA) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3 and 10 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (Television Programme)

(Department of Broadcasting Malaysia) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2022.

Interpretation

2. In this Order, "Director General" means the Director General of the

Department of Broadcasting Malaysia.

Fees and payment

3. (1) The fees prescribed in columns (2) and (3) of the Schedule shall be paid

to the Director General for the supply of television programme in accordance with

the categories specified in column (1) and shall be charged by the hour for each broadcast

of the television programme.

(2) The fees prescribed in column (4) of the Schedule shall be paid

to the Director General for the supply of television programme in accordance with

the categories specified in column (1) and shall be charged by the hour for each

television programme.

Remission

4. The Director General may remit the fees prescribed under this Order either wholly

or in part or generally or in any particular case or class of cases.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 3]

1. For the purposes of this Schedule, "television programme for limited broadcast"

means a television programme which is broadcasted repeatedly in a building,

premise or public transport.
